notes: LiteRT-LM omni/asr at main@66058c82, self-built (bazel 7.6.1; macOS: Xcode 27, Android: NDK r28 --config=android_arm64), engine defaults (window = model_metadata inputMilliseconds, overlap 0.4, timestamp merger). Numbers, per-utterance outputs and the analysis: https://github.com/john-rocky/edge-llm-bench/blob/main/results/raw/2026-09-25-omni-asr-wer-v1-m4max-mac/NOTES.md Same runner source built for Android (NDK r28), CPU only.
quantization: int8 dynamic-range weights, fp32 activations (drq); 5 s window (litert-community/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3)

evidence: Open ASR Leaderboard scoring (EnglishTextNormalizer + corpus WER, jiwer) over LibriSpeech test-clean (2620 utt, 5.403 h) and test-other (2939 utt, 5.342 h); harness = omni_eval_runner on LiteRT-LM OmniEngine (omni/asr, PushInputSource, one session per utterance, CPU num_threads 4), edge-llm-bench tools/omni-eval. WER is pipeline-level (engine front-end + model + decoder), not the .tflite alone; 'hung' = never returned from TdtDecoder::Decode, killed by the driver watchdog and scored as empty; RTFx = audio seconds / engine wall seconds.

https://github.com/john-rocky/edge-llm-bench/blob/main/results/raw/2026-09-25-omni-asr-wer-v1-s26-android/NOTES.md: each cell waits for the battery to cool to 36 C first; the phone was at thermal status 2-3 by the end of each cell (in the RTFx, not in the text); whisper-tiny S/D/I byte-identical to the Mac CPU run
peak_rss_mb in the S26 summaries is not a valid measurement (1.4) and is omitted
